mapper.select: select r.dates, u.pkg, IFNULL(uv.max_pvn, 'unknown') version, IFNULL(uv.min_pvn, 'unknown') register_version, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, u.create_time register_date, u.dates register_dates, CONVERT(r.user_id, SIGNED) user_id, type, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(CONVERT(r.time_stamp, SIGNED) / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') create_time from ods_offer_record r LEFT JOIN ods_user u on (r.user_id = u.id) LEFT JOIN ods_user_hema uh on (uh.aid = u.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, max(pvn) max_pvn, min(pvn) min_pvn FROM ods_user_version where dates <= #{dates} GROUP BY user_id) uv ON r.user_id = uv.user_id where r.dates = #{dates} and r.user_id REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$' limit #{rows} offset #{startRows}
select count(r.id) from ods_offer_record r where r.dates = #{dates} and r.user_id REGEXP '^-?[0-9]+$'

SELECT r.dates, u.pkg, IFNULL(uv.max_pvn, 'unknown') version, IFNULL(uv.min_pvn, 'unknown') register_version, IFNULL(uh.address, 'IN') country, u.create_time register_date, u.dates register_dates, u.id user_id, r.type, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(CONVERT(r.time_stamp, SIGNED) / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') create_time FROM ods_offer_record r LEFT JOIN ods_user u ON r.user_id = u.aid left join ods_user_hema uh on (uh.aid = u.aid and uh.pkg = u.pkg) LEFT JOIN (SELECT user_id, max(pvn) max_pvn, min(pvn) min_pvn FROM ods_user_version where dates <= #{dates} GROUP BY user_id) uv ON u.id = uv.user_id WHERE r.dates = #{dates} AND u.id IS NOT NULL limit #{rows} offset #{startRows}
SELECT count(r.id) FROM ods_offer_record r LEFT JOIN ods_user u ON r.user_id = u.aid WHERE r.dates = #{dates} AND u.id IS NOT NULL
